headline: US stocks rose on Friday as technology shares recovered from Thursday's AI-led sell-off, ending the week higher.
score_reason: Keeps the pool score: a full market-day wrap with AI at the centre; the closing figures match a second outlet.
importance_line: What changed is that AI-heavy shares bounced back after a one-day scare over OpenAI's revenue, which matters first to savers whose retirement funds hold these shares and to households facing weak confidence and high prices, then to investors, and the doubt is that one day's move says little about whether AI spending will pay off.
summary: Yahoo Finance reports that US stocks rose on Friday 9 Oct 2026, with the S&P 500 up 0.59%, the Nasdaq Composite up 0.64% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.83%, as tech shares recovered from Thursday's AI-led drop. That drop followed reports, covered in our 9 Oct 2026 edition, that OpenAI's annualized revenue (recent sales scaled to a full year) was near $50 billion; a further report, also carried in that edition, says OpenAI expects about $70 billion by the end of the year, while a University of Michigan survey put consumer sentiment at a five-month low.
notes: Read the original page in full. Follow-up of the OpenAI revenue sell-off (8 Oct 2026); the index closes were cross-checked against BigGo Finance.
